user.title: Add Shelly BLE Relay
user.description: Select the Shelly Bluetooth device to add. If it is already bonded to Home Assistant, the existing bond will be validated automatically. This works over a local Bluetooth adapter or an ESPHome Bluetooth proxy.

data_description.address: Select a discovered Shelly Bluetooth device. If the device is not already paired, you will be prompted to enable Bluetooth pairing mode.

pairing.title: Bluetooth pairing required
pairing.description:
A Bluetooth RPC connection to {device} ({address}) could not be validated.

Put the Shelly into Bluetooth pairing mode. The pairing window lasts approximately 180 seconds.

With a local Bluetooth adapter, Home Assistant performs the pairing itself. With an ESPHome Bluetooth proxy, keep the Shelly close to the proxy and select Retry pairing: the proxy connects and builds the bond during the pairing window.

Select Retry pairing once pairing mode is active. Use the X in the upper-left to cancel.

menu_option_descriptions.retry_pairing: Attempt Bluetooth pairing with the Shelly now. With an ESPHome Bluetooth proxy, the proxy performs the bond during this attempt.

pairing_failed.title: Bluetooth pairing failed

retry_pairing_progress.title: Retrying Bluetooth pairing
retry_pairing_progress.description: Connecting to {device} ({address}) and verifying Bluetooth RPC communication. Bonding over an ESPHome Bluetooth proxy may take a few seconds.

error.invalid_address: Enter a Bluetooth MAC address in AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF format.

abort.already_configured: This Bluetooth device is already configured.
abort.missing_pending_device: The pending Shelly device information was lost. Start the add-device flow again.
